import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Transaction Amount by Type
sns.barplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
for i, v in enumerate(df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()):
    axes[0, 0].text(i, v + 10, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Transaction Count by Type
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(type_counts))
axes[0, 1].pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors, startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Distribution by Type')

# Plot 3: Transactions by Hour of Day
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', 
                s=100, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Type')

# Plot 4: Amount Distribution with Box Plot
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[1, 1], palette='viridis')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# Add fraud status annotation
fraud_rate = df['is_fraud'].mean() * 100
fig.text(0.5, 0.02, f'Fraud Rate: {fraud_rate:.1f}% | Total Transactions: {len(df)}', 
         ha='center', fontsize=10, style='italic')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.04, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
